name: Maneuver
desc: Move up to 2 Meters; Does not Provoke Attacks.

stat.effects: Move up to 2 Meters; Does not Provoke Attacks.

name: Move
desc: Move up to your Movement using one of your Speeds; Provokes Attacks when leaving Engagement.

stat.effects: Move up to your Movement using one of your Speeds; Provokes Attacks when leaving Engagement.

name: Leap
desc: Move up to half your Movement horizontally and up to one fourth your Movement Vertically. If your Body exceeds 10, you can move up to half your Movement Vertically; Provokes Attacks when Leaving Enga…

stat.effects: Move up to half your Movement horizontally and up to one fourth your Movement Vertically. If your Body exceeds 10, you can move up to half your Movement Vertically; Provokes Attacks when Leaving Engagement.

name: Strike
desc: Make a Melee Attack against an Engaged Target. If you succeed, you Damage them with the Weapon used.

stat.effects: Make a Melee Attack against an Engaged Target. If you succeed, you Damage them with the Weapon used.

name: Shoot
desc: Target something in your Wielded Ranged Weapon's Range and make a Ranged Attack with AP Boons. If you succeed, you Damage them with the Weapon. You can Attack something outside of your Weapon's Range…

stat.effects:
Target something in your Wielded Ranged Weapon's Range and make a Ranged Attack with AP Boons. If you succeed, you Damage them with the Weapon.
You can Attack something outside of your Weapon's Range, but you suffer a Bane for every 2 Meters.
Provokes Attacks from Engaged Enemies.

name: Throw
desc: Make a Ranged Attack against a Target within the Range of your Weapon, plus your Body and AP spent (Weapons with no listed Rang only use your Body). If you succeed, they are struck by it.

stat.effects: Make a Ranged Attack against a Target within the Range of your Weapon, plus your Body and AP spent (Weapons with no listed Rang only use your Body). If you succeed, they are struck by it.

name: Brace
desc: You become Restrained, but gain a Bonus to Ranged Attacks up to your Tier. Maneuvering ends this.

stat.effects: You become Restrained, but gain a Bonus to Ranged Attacks up to your Tier. Maneuvering ends this.

name: Load
desc: Replenish the ammunition of a ranged weapon. The AP cost depends on the Weapon.

stat.effects: Replenish the ammunition of a ranged weapon. The AP cost depends on the Weapon.

name: Swipe
desc: Make Potence or Action Test against the Principle Skill of an Engaged Target's choice. If you succeed, you take something held in their Hands.

stat.effects: Make Potence or Action Test against the Principle Skill of an Engaged Target's choice. If you succeed, you take something held in their Hands.

name: Bar
desc: For 1 Round, Creatures must succeed an Action or Potence Test against your Action or Vitality (your choice) to leave your Engagement. If you are larger, their Test is made with 2 Banes, or 2 Boons if…

stat.effects: For 1 Round, Creatures must succeed an Action or Potence Test against your Action or Vitality (your choice) to leave your Engagement. If you are larger, their Test is made with 2 Banes, or 2 Boons if you are smaller.

name: Flank
desc: Target a Creature in Engagement. The next Attack made against them is easier, up to the amount of AP spent.

stat.effects: Target a Creature in Engagement. The next Attack made against them is easier, up to the amount of AP spent.

name: Grab
desc: Make an Opposed Action or Vitality against the Potence of a Creature you can Touch. If you succeed, the Target becomes Restrained and Linked to you. You must have at least one free Hand to Grab.

stat.effects: Make an Opposed Action or Vitality against the Potence of a Creature you can Touch. If you succeed, the Target becomes Restrained and Linked to you. You must have at least one free Hand to Grab.

name: Mantle
desc: Make an Action or Potence Test against an Engaged Target's Potence. If you succeed, you clamber onto and become Linked to them. (You Cannot Mantle a Creature which is smaller than you.)

stat.effects: Make an Action or Potence Test against an Engaged Target's Potence. If you succeed, you clamber onto and become Linked to them. (You Cannot Mantle a Creature which is smaller than you.)

name: Push
desc: Make an Opposed Action or Vitality Test against a Target you can Touch. If you succeed, they are moved AP Meters away from you.

stat.effects: Make an Opposed Action or Vitality Test against a Target you can Touch. If you succeed, they are moved AP Meters away from you.

name: Trip
desc: Make a Darkness or Action Test against the Potence of a Target you can Touch, knocking them Prone on a success.

stat.effects: Make a Darkness or Action Test against the Potence of a Target you can Touch, knocking them Prone on a success.

name: Ready
desc: Choose any action you could perform on this turn, spend that action's cost in AP and designate a trigger. If that trigger occurs before the start of your next Turn, you may perform the chosen action.

stat.effects: Choose any action you could perform on this turn, spend that action's cost in AP and designate a trigger. If that trigger occurs before the start of your next Turn, you may perform the chosen action.

name: Communicate
desc: Speak, gesticulate, whisper, point or otherwise convey a meaning to another Creature. Pointing to or otherwise indicating something requires you to Target it.

stat.effects: Speak, gesticulate, whisper, point or otherwise convey a meaning to another Creature. Pointing to or otherwise indicating something requires you to Target it.

name: Gauge
desc: Target a Creature and make a Luminance, Traversal, or Unity Test against their Tier. Succeed or fail, you learn their Tier and Skills. On a success, you also learn their Abilities, Armor Rating, and…

stat.effects: Target a Creature and make a Luminance, Traversal, or Unity Test against their Tier. Succeed or fail, you learn their Tier and Skills. On a success, you also learn their Abilities, Armor Rating, and any Resistences or Weaknesses.

name: Interaction
desc: You manipulate something, usually by hand. Unless otherwise specified, the Target must be within Touch Range. The GM may increase the AP needed for this Action at their Discretion.

stat.effects: You manipulate something, usually by hand. Unless otherwise specified, the Target must be within Touch Range. The GM may increase the AP needed for this Action at their Discretion.

name: Spot
desc: Make a Luminance Test against the Darkness of something in Cover from you. Success allows you to Detect and Target it for the rest of your Turn.

stat.effects: Make a Luminance Test against the Darkness of something in Cover from you. Success allows you to Detect and Target it for the rest of your Turn.

name: Hold your Breath
desc: In response to an effect that would Suffocate you, you become immune to Suffocation for Minutes equal to half your base Body.

stat.effects: In response to an effect that would Suffocate you, you become immune to Suffocation for Minutes equal to half your base Body.

name: Struggle
desc: When Restrained by a Grab, make an Action or Vitality Test against the same Skill of the Creature holding you, ending the Condition on a success.

name: Attack of Opportunity
desc: Target a foe who triggers this Reaction as if with a 1 AP Strike. All Actions and Feats that trigger these state when and how they "Provoke an Attack".

stat.effects: Target a foe who triggers this Reaction as if with a 1 AP Strike. All Actions and Feats that trigger these state when and how they "Provoke an Attack".

name: Aid
desc: If an ally sharing your Engagement makes a Test with a Skill you have at least 1 rank in, they gain a Boon.

stat.effects: If an ally sharing your Engagement makes a Test with a Skill you have at least 1 rank in, they gain a Boon.

name: Preempt
desc: Target a Creature and roll 2d6+(Your Mind Bonus) against their Tier, if you succeed, you move ahead of them in the Turn Order (which can interrupt their Turn,) but only regain 2 AP instead of 3. Your…

stat.effects: Target a Creature and roll 2d6+(Your Mind Bonus) against their Tier, if you succeed, you move ahead of them in the Turn Order (which can interrupt their Turn,) but only regain 2 AP instead of 3. Your Turn gained in this way cannot, itself, be Preempted.

name: Roll
desc: When you suffer Damage from Falling, make an Action or Potence Test against DC_(8+half the number of Meters fallen). Success negates the Damage, failure reduces its Viciousness by your Tier.

stat.effects: When you suffer Damage from Falling, make an Action or Potence Test against DC_(8+half the number of Meters fallen). Success negates the Damage, failure reduces its Viciousness by your Tier.

name: Block
desc: When you are the Target of a Melee Attack, you can subject a Melee Weapon or Shield Wielded by you to the Damage instead. This Notches the Items used, as if it were Armor Rated for the Damage Type. I…

stat.effects:
When you are the Target of a Melee Attack, you can subject a Melee Weapon or Shield Wielded by you to the Damage instead.
This Notches the Items used, as if it were Armor Rated for the Damage Type.
If this Damage Breaks the Item used to Block, you also suffer the Damage.
